t: Sika 360 Level is a high-performance, deep fill self-levelling compound designed for preparing subfloors. This fibre-modified, cement-based powder effectively levels uneven floors and screeds from 3-60mm in depth, making it ideal for preparing surfaces in busy commercial spaces or residential renovations. It is also suitable for the embedment of underfloor heating systems. The formulation includes powdered polymer, eliminating the need for separate latex liquids. When mixed, it creates a free-flowing solution that sets in just 4 hours and allows for overlaying after only 8 hours, ensuring efficient project completion.
b: Rapid Setting: Overlaid in Just 8 Hours
Durable Finish for Various Floor Coverings
